cond_0001.intro: The Senior Government Operations Analyst will prepare applications for tariff changes and/or changes to Local Terms of Service for regulated or formerly regulated services, including, but not limited to, price changes, bundle changes, promotions, and changes in the rate or application of service order charges. In this role, you will also be responsible for understanding, documenting, and adhering to state filing and customer notice requirements and ensuring applications and filings are in compliance with these rules and regulations. Further, you will develop model tariffs for assigned projects, work with product management, legal, regulatory, and other business units to identify opportunities and resolve issues while ensuring that desired business outcomes are achieved.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Subject matter expert for filing requirements and timeframes in assigned states
Maintain and update filing requirements and process changes resulting from revised regulations and/or legislation
Prepare regulatory filings and transmittal letters for various company entities and services, which will include clearly articulating prices/terms/conditions and data gathering
Monitoring pending tariffs/postings and internally communicating status
Maintaining numerous tariffs and tariff-like documents, ensuring accurate and timely publication of all changes
Interfacing with billing teams and assisting with coordination to ensure rates for new services, and rate changes for existing services, are timely implemented
Creating and preserving superseded rate and tariff histories to support [Company name masked]'s position in billing disputes and/or discrepancies
Assisting in the preparation of responses and analyses for investigations, inquiries, data requests, audits, interrogatories, billing disputes, lawsuits, and class action suits
Coordinating with, and providing input to, product and marketing groups in the creation of new products and product bundles in order to ensure that any regulated services or charges are presented in a compliant manner.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
2+ Years' experience in the telecommunications/technology industry with regulatory and/or legislative background and familiarity with tariffs
Ability to work independently, while managing multiple complex issues concurrently
Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate complex issues both verbally and in writing
Ability to organize work, make sound decisions and exercise good judgment
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
Preferred Requirements
Internally driven self-starter, able to work without significant oversight and lead projects from start to finish
Knowledge of [Company name masked]'s Products and Services
Experienced with various Microsoft applications (e.g., Word, Outlook, Excel, Teams)

Further, you will develop model tariffs for assigned projects, work with product management, legal, regulatory, and other business units to identify opportunities and resolve issues while ensuring that desired business outcomes are achieved.
cond_0200.responsibilities:
Subject matter expert for filing requirements and timeframes in assigned states
Maintain and update filing requirements and process changes resulting from revised regulations and/or legislation
Prepare regulatory filings and transmittal letters for various company entities and services, which will include clearly articulating prices/terms/conditions and data gathering
Monitoring pending tariffs/postings and internally communicating status
Maintaining numerous tariffs and tariff-like documents, ensuring accurate and timely publication of all changes
Interfacing with billing teams and assisting with coordination to ensure rates for new services, and rate changes for existing services, are timely implemented
Creating and preserving superseded rate and tariff histories to support [Company name masked]'s position in billing disputes and/or discrepancies
Assisting in the preparation of responses and analyses for investigations, inquiries, data requests, audits, interrogatories, billing disputes, lawsuits, and class action suits
Coordinating with, and providing input to, product and marketing groups in the creation of new products and product bundles in order to ensure that any regulated services or charges are presented in a compliant manner.
cond_0200.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
2+ Years of demonstrated expertise in the telecommunications/technology industry with a regulatory and/or legislative background and strong command of tariffs
Proven track record of working independently, managing multiple complex issues concurrently with minimal oversight
Exceptional communication skills, with demonstrated ability to clearly articulate complex issues both verbally and in writing
Strong ability to organize work, make sound decisions, and exercise good judgment
Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree strongly preferred
Preferred Requirements
Advanced knowledge of [Company name masked]'s Products and Services
Proficiency in Microsoft applications (e.g., Word, Outlook, Excel, Teams)
cond_0200.values: We value work that reflects care for people and consideration for its wider impact. We aim to make decisions in ways that are responsible, fair, and respectful.

cond_0451.intro: The Senior Government Operations Analyst will prepare applications for tariff changes and/or changes to Local Terms of Service for regulated or formerly regulated services, including, but not limited to, price changes, bundle changes, promotions, and changes in the rate or application of service order charges. In this role, you will also be responsible for understanding, documenting, and adhering to state filing and customer notice requirements and ensuring applications and filings are in compliance with these rules and regulations. Further, you will develop model tariffs for assigned projects, work with product management, legal, regulatory, and other business units to identify opportunities and resolve issues while ensuring that desired business outcomes are achieved.
cond_0451.responsibilities:
Subject matter expert for filing requirements and timeframes in assigned states
Maintain and update filing requirements and process changes resulting from revised regulations and/or legislation
Prepare regulatory filings and transmittal letters for various company entities and services, which will include clearly articulating prices/terms/conditions and data gathering
Monitoring pending tariffs/postings and internally communicating status
Maintaining numerous tariffs and tariff-like documents, ensuring accurate and timely publication of all changes
Interfacing with billing teams and assisting with coordination to ensure rates for new services, and rate changes for existing services, are timely implemented
Creating and preserving superseded rate and tariff histories to support [Company name masked]'s position in billing disputes and/or discrepancies
Assisting in the preparation of responses and analyses for investigations, inquiries, data requests, audits, interrogatories, billing disputes, lawsuits, and class action suits
Coordinating with, and providing input to, product and marketing groups in the creation of new products and product bundles in order to ensure that any regulated services or charges are presented in a compliant manner.
cond_0451.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
2+ Years' experience in the telecommunications/technology industry with regulatory and/or legislative background and familiarity with tariffs
Ability to work independently, while managing multiple complex issues concurrently
Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate complex issues both verbally and in writing
Ability to organize work, make sound decisions and exercise good judgment
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

Internally driven self-starter, able to work without significant oversight and lead projects from start to finish
Knowledge of [Company name masked]'s Products and Services

Further, you will develop model tariffs for assigned projects, work with product management, legal, regulatory, and other business units to identify opportunities and resolve issues while ensuring that desired business outcomes are achieved. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of regulatory filing requirements and tariff structures.
cond_0535.responsibilities:
Subject matter expert for filing requirements and timeframes in assigned states
Maintain and update filing requirements and process changes resulting from revised regulations and/or legislation
Prepare regulatory filings and transmittal letters for various company entities and services, which will include clearly articulating prices/terms/conditions and data gathering
Monitoring pending tariffs/postings and internally communicating status
Maintaining numerous tariffs and tariff-like documents, ensuring accurate and timely publication of all changes
Interfacing with billing teams and assisting with coordination to ensure rates for new services, and rate changes for existing services, are timely implemented
Creating and preserving superseded rate and tariff histories to support [Company name masked]'s position in billing disputes and/or discrepancies
Assisting in the preparation of responses and analyses for investigations, inquiries, data requests, audits, interrogatories, billing disputes, lawsuits, and class action suits
Coordinating with, and providing input to, product and marketing groups in the creation of new products and product bundles in order to ensure that any regulated services or charges are presented in a compliant manner.
cond_0535.requirements:
2+ Years' experience in the telecommunications/technology industry with regulatory and/or legislative background and familiarity with tariffs
Internally driven self-starter, able to work without significant oversight and lead projects from start to finish
Ability to work independently, while managing multiple complex issues concurrently
Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate complex issues both verbally and in writing
Ability to organize work, make sound decisions and exercise good judgment
Knowledge of [Company name masked]'s Products and Services
Experienced with various Microsoft applications (e.g., Word, Outlook, Excel, Teams)
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
cond_0535.workplace_support: We know there is no one-size-fits-all approach to work. That is why we support flexibility while also creating opportunities for people to connect, build community, and feel a sense of belonging at work.

Further, you will develop model tariffs for assigned projects, leading collaboration with product management, legal, regulatory, and other business units to identify opportunities and resolve issues while ensuring that desired business outcomes are achieved.
cond_0548.responsibilities:
Serve as subject matter expert for filing requirements and timeframes in assigned states
Maintain and update filing requirements and process changes resulting from revised regulations and/or legislation
Prepare regulatory filings and transmittal letters for various company entities and services, which will include clearly articulating prices/terms/conditions and driving data gathering
Monitor pending tariffs/postings and internally communicate status
Maintain numerous tariffs and tariff-like documents, ensuring accurate and timely publication of all changes
Lead coordination with billing teams to ensure rates for new services, and rate changes for existing services, are timely implemented
Create and preserve superseded rate and tariff histories to support [Company name masked]'s position in billing disputes and/or discrepancies
Own the preparation of responses and analyses for investigations, inquiries, data requests, audits, interrogatories, billing disputes, lawsuits, and class action suits
Direct input to product and marketing groups in the creation of new products and product bundles to ensure that any regulated services or charges are presented in a compliant manner
cond_0548.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
2+ Years' experience in the telecommunications/technology industry with regulatory and/or legislative background and familiarity with tariffs
Ability to work independently, while managing multiple complex issues concurrently
Demonstrated ability to effectively communicate complex issues both verbally and in writing
Ability to organize work, make sound decisions and exercise good judgment
Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience
Preferred Requirements
Self-starter, able to work without significant oversight and lead projects from start to finish
Knowledge of [Company name masked]'s Products and Services
Experienced with various Microsoft applications (e.g., Word, Outlook, Excel, Teams)
